ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to throw his lemon slice, knocking the target back a short distance{STAT}

{FLAVOR}After the rock incident, Dave keeps owing him more and more. Acid Lemon is fine with anything at this point: share an ice-cream cone, pay for a bus ticket or heck, just a regular verbal apology. So far he's received a frozen Conehead Zombie, a ride to a zombie-infested dead end and wouldn't you know it, another hit on the head with a rock! He closes his interview with "Genies are real, and they're amongst us."
ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Acid Lemon shoots corrosive juice that deals extra sour damage to metals and armor. Has a chance to throw a lemon slice for even more damage and a brief knockback.
ACIDLEMON_TOOLTIP: Deals extra damage to metallic or bulky armor and zombies
AILMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Ail-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Blooming Heart
{STAT}Chili Bean
{STAT}Fume-shroom
{STAT}Garlic
{STAT}Goo Peashooter
{STAT}Imp Pear
{STAT}Lily of Alchemy
{STAT}Perfume-shroom
{STAT}Puff-shroom
{STAT}Shadow-shroom
{STAT}Spore-shroom

{FLAVOR}Second cousin to Shadow-shroom, she doesn't get cool glowy powers when near Moonflower. The family always brings it up at gatherings: "Why can't you be more like your cousin?" they say. Ail-mint doesn't know how much longer she can take it.
AILMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.
AKEE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each subsequent bounce deals less damage

{FLAVOR}Autonomous Katapulting Ejectomatic Emitter is actively looking for a different acronym for A.K.E.E. because let's face it, "Katapulting" is just not working.
AKEE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A.K.E.E.s lob projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.
AKEE_TOOLTIP: Lobs projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}activates when plant is damaged
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't heal Chard Guard, Holly Barrier and Buttercup

{FLAVOR}Aloe likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Aloes heal injured plants to their immediate right.
APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Appease-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Electric Peashooter
{STAT}Fire Peashooter
{STAT}Goo Peashooter
{STAT}Pea Pod
{STAT}Peashooter
{STAT}Primal Peashooter
{STAT}Repeater
{STAT}Shadow Peashooter
{STAT}Snow Pea
{STAT}Sling Pea
{STAT}Split Pea
{STAT}Threepeater
{STAT}Tumbleweed

{FLAVOR}Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"
APPEASEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Appease-mints provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Apple Mortar blasts three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!
APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Apple Mortars launch heavy-damage apple cores down three lanes.
APPLEMORTAR_TOOLTIP: Lobs heavy-damage cores down three lanes
ARMAMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Arma-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}A.K.E.E.
{STAT}Apple Mortar
{STAT}Banana Launcher
{STAT}Blastberry Vine
{STAT}Blooming Heart
{STAT}Cabbage-pult
{STAT}Coconut Cannon
{STAT}Dusk Lobber
{STAT}Kernel-pult
{STAT}Melon-pult
{STAT}Missile Toe
{STAT}Pepper-pult
{STAT}Sap-fling
{STAT}Sling Pea
{STAT}Spore-shroom
{STAT}Stickybomb Rice
{STAT}Strawburst
{STAT}Turkey-pult
{STAT}Winter Melon

{FLAVOR}"Lobbing projectiles, for me, has always been a very personal endeavor," says Arma-mint. "It's a great way for me to express myself, my identity, and my preference that zombies be defeated in large groups."
ARMAMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Arma-mints launch a volley of heavy stunning projectiles and provide a temporary boost to all Arma-mint Family plants on the lawn.
ASPARAGUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Often confused for his old army captain, Aceparagus has a hard time carving out his own identity. It's hard living in someone else's shadow, almost like this entire aerial assault is a shadow of something urban from a different reality. No, that can't be.
ASPARAGUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Aceparagus deals burst damage in his surrounding rows, needing to reload after using up his ammo.
ASPARAGUS_TOOLTIP: Attacks zombies in front and adjacent lanes
BANANA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in small area

{FLAVOR}It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... Banana Launcher is TOTALLY bananas.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Banana Launchers can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
BANANA_TOOLTIP: Tap on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire spike leaf pierces through 2 zombies, makes them Lovesick and lowers their damage; ice spike leaf pierces through 4 zombies, makes them Heartbreak and chills them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chill effect can't be removed by fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with both the fire and ice spike leaf get Heartbroken and take more damage from attacks
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spike leaf deals extra 40 damage if zombies have other spike leaf effect
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}When three universes crashed together, not only was untold Zombie chaos unleashed within the Lunar Rainbow Market, but a very powerful plant was born to combat the crisis. Begonia is a plant only said in legend, and came into being to stop the Zombie scourge once and for all. Strange that the last collision didn't wake her up, though.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Begonias randomly throw two types of spike leaves that can stack to increase damage taken by zombies.
BEGONIA_TOOLTIP: Throws icy and fiery spike leaves that increase damage taken by zombies
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Blastberry Vine snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He’s been reading up on it and he knows it’s gonna make a big splash when it happens. "Soon," he whispers.
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blastberry Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
BLASTBERRY_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside and lobs damaging berries
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannot be dug by Excavator Zombie or pulled by Fisherman Zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Blockoli isn't afraid of being eaten, that's life on the battlefield. What he does fear however, is not being tasty when it does eventually happen. He fancies himself as quite a delicious plant when prepared right, and to deny that potential would be a great insult. As a matter of fact, he's willing to offer tips and suggestions on how it could be done during his off time. His fellow greens aren't as enthusiastic as him on the topic of how they could be prepared for a dish in some water cooler talks, however.
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blockoli dual-wields two sturdy floret shields, slamming them down to stun and block approaching zombies.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the first new member to your home defense team, Bloomerang enjoys long walkabouts with his friend, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bloomerangs can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!
BLOOMERANG_TOOLTIP: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}40 (projectile), 15 per damage stack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}damage increases across multiple Blooming Hearts

{FLAVOR}Blooming Heart loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blooming Hearts lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing increasing damage the more they hit.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_TOOLTIP: Lobs projectiles that do more damage the more they hit
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away all flying zombies

{FLAVOR}The luckiest stunt clover around, Blover is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty," and "Finding Flower." He also teaches a stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blovers blow away all zombies in the air.
BLOVER_TOOLTIP: Blows away all flying and floating zombies
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}heavily damages various grid items
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}destroys critters

{FLAVOR}Boingsetta's a springy plant whose positive outlook is infectiously delightful! The chilling effect is merely a secondary consequence.
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Boingsettas slam the ground in a "boing" that heavily damages grid items and chills zombies.
BOINGSETTA_TOOLTIP: Damages grid items and chills zombies
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Bombard-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Banana Launcher
{STAT}Berry Blaster
{STAT}Bombegranate
{STAT}Cherry Bomb
{STAT}Dandelion
{STAT}Escape Root
{STAT}Explode-O-Nut
{STAT}Ghost Pepper
{STAT}Grapeshot
{STAT}Potato Mine
{STAT}Primal Potato Mine
{STAT}Strawburst

{FLAVOR}"Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombard-mints set off a massive explosion on board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Bombegranate is explosive, but she likes to think there's more to her than that. She's also deciduous and exarillate!
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombegranates explode and leave 3x3 grids of exploding seeds that damage zombies.
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bonk Choys rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
BONKCHOY_TOOLTIP: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap or drag from Boom Balloon Flower to move a balloon to a tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}balloons gain an additional 300 damage per stack

{FLAVOR}Boom Balloon Flower's balloons are inflated with hydrogen and aerosolized kerosene. It's an anti-safety measure.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Boom Balloon Flowers spawn exploding balloons that can be placed anywhere on the lawn as traps for zombies.
BOOMFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap to place a mine, mines can be stacked for more damage
BOSS_BUSTER_CANNON_DESCRIPTION: Inflicts up to {DAMAGE} damage to bosses every {TIME} seconds!
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}larger bulbs do more damage

{FLAVOR}Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah, sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bowling Bulbs roll shots that can bounce into multiple zombies.
BOWLINGBULB_TOOLTIP: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can pull the armor off certain zombies when trapped
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}berry clusters show traps remaining

{FLAVOR}Many friends and family members advised him to pursue a different career, something more along the lines of viticulture along with the other vines, with him being told that his current career is a trap. He never thought they were so literal about it until he graduated, but he never had the best hindsight.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bramble Bush traps and damages a zombie.
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates buttering butter splats

{FLAVOR}Buttercup's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat 25 sun cost. "I'm reasonable."
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Buttercup butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Cabbage-pult received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cabbage-pults hurl cabbages at the enemy.
CABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hides and does ground damage when zombies are near

{FLAVOR}Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she’s just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies!
CACTUS_TOOLTIP: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kernels deal splash damage on a single tile and slow zombies on impact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bags of popcorn deal splash damage and slow zombies in an area around them

{FLAVOR}"Me and Kernel-pult? We're on good terms," she answers. "I fling caramel and he flings butter, but we both look for the same results, work towards the same goal. I'm tired of people trying to create fake drama, who said that you can't mix sweet with salty?"
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Caramel Popcorn lobs zombie-slowing caramelized corn kernels and bags of popcorn.
CARAMELPOPCORN_TOOLTIP: Flings caramelized corn kernels and popcorn bags at zombies
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Celery Stalker resents the implication that there’s anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Celery Stalkers wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.
CELERYSTALKER_TOOLTIP: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You might remember Chard Guard from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring – boy-oh-boy – he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when Chard Guard is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver – it gets 'em every time.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chard Guards are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with the cheese deal less damage to plants

{FLAVOR}Cheese Strawberry wasn't supposed to be here. He slipped into a parcel and stowed away when the Jinjin Tea Shop sent it out to a mysterious customer, and thus sent him on an interdimensional trip to a world unlike anything he saw before. But that didn't matter much to him, because all that did was give him a free trip to try the new foreign cheese! How could you say no to that?
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cheese Strawberry lobs smelly cheese that makes zombies nauseated, lowering their eating damage.
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_TOOLTIP: Lobs smelly cheese that lowers zombie eating damage
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}The Cherry Bomb Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cherry Bombs can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
CHERRY_BOMB_TOOLTIP: Blows up all zombies in a medium area
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}eating zombie is destroyed and releases stunning gas
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress.
CHILIBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 12 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be devoured

{FLAVOR}Everyone appreciates what Chomper does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, Chomper's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chompers can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
CHOMPER_TOOLTIP: Devours a zombie, then chews on it for a while
CITRON_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, Citron is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"
CITRON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Citrons shoot powerful balls of plasma.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in medium area

{FLAVOR}Sure, he's a hairy old man, but Coconut Cannon can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Coconut Cannons fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
COCONUTCANNON_TOOLTIP: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants affected by buff attack faster until effect runs out
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The current spokesman for an energy drink owned by Rodeo Legend Zombies, Coffee Bean has considered stepping down after the unintended side-effects of a viral marketing campaign have taken a toll on him.
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Coffee Bean wakes up plants in a 3x3 area.
COFFEEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Wakes up plants in a 3x3 area
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Area: {STAT}slows and damages zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

{FLAVOR}Cold Snapdragon gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin Snapdragon. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cold Snapdragons breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP: Breathes icy mist in an area in front of it
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Conceal-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Dusk Lobber
{STAT}Grimrose
{STAT}Moonflower
{STAT}Murkadamia Nut
{STAT}Nightshade
{STAT}Shadow Peashooter
{STAT}Shadow-shroom

{FLAVOR}Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Contain-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Apple Mortar
{STAT}Blover
{STAT}Chili Bean
{STAT}Dazey Chain
{STAT}Fanilla
{STAT}Grave Buster
{STAT}Hurrikale
{STAT}Magnet-shroom
{STAT}Olive Pit
{STAT}Sap-fling
{STAT}Solar Tomato
{STAT}Spring Bean
{STAT}Stallia
{STAT}Stunion
{STAT}Tumbleweed

{FLAVOR}"Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
CONVERSION_KEY_DESCRIPTION:
Your progress and rewards have been preserved. Your unused keys have been turned into coins!

{COINT_AMT} Coins!
CONVERSION_REWARDS_DESCRIPTION:
Updating your progress has given you new rewards!

Details are available in the Almanac.
CONVERSION_SPLASH_DESCRIPTION:
• Travel to new worlds faster.
• NEW Turbo speed feature.
• Gargantuar battles in every world.
CONVERSION_STARS_DESCRIPTION:
Your progress and rewards have been preserved. Plant costumes have been awarded to you for the extra Stars you've earned.

{COSTUME_AMT} New Costumes!
CONVERSION_WORLDKEY_DESCRIPTION: You've been awarded a World Key for your progress in the game. Use it to unlock the world of your choice!
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, in order of priority "middle - below - above"
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}may react to certain strong winds

{FLAVOR}"Look," says Dandelion, shaking his head. "I’m not a leprechaun and I’m not a genie. You can blow my seeds off all you want, but I can't make your wish come true. I don’t even know how that rumor got started."
DANDELION_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dandelions send explosive seeds down three different lanes, one lane at a time.
DANDELION_TOOLTIP: Attacks multiple lanes, one lane at a time
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}will target stronger specials in its lane before other zombies
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}has a limited supply of darts, then must recharge

{FLAVOR}"Why waste shots on foot soldiers when you can win the battle with one well-chosen dart to the dome?" wonders Dartichoke. "Why would you do it? Why would ANYONE do it?"
DARTICHOKE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dartichokes fire high-damage darts down the lane, prioritizing especially dangerous zombies such as Wizards, Octo Zombies, and Fishermen.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}grows and releases stalling gas every fifteen shots, can grow a maximum of twice

{FLAVOR}"I use they/them pronouns," says Dazey Chain. "Duh," they add.
DAZEYCHAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dazey Chains grow through stages, becoming more powerful and releasing a stalling puff of gas at each stage.
DAZEYCHAIN_TOOLTIP: Grows flowers from time to time and stalls zombies
DINONIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}affects all dinosaurs in a lane
{FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
DINONIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}air cannon blasts have a chance to blow away critters, imps and shrunken zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food blasts knock flying zombies off the lawn

{FLAVOR}Draftodil looks like she's full of hot air, but she isn't. She's full of highly compressed air. There's a difference!
DRAFTODIL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Draftodils windmill constantly, slowing flying zombies, and also shoot air cannon blasts that deal light damage to zombies.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Dusk Lobbers lob buds down 3 lanes

{FLAVOR}Lobbing comes easily to Dusk Lobber, but that's only because she's had extensive training and really enjoys parabolas.
DUSKLOBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Dusk Lobbers are shadow plants that lob explosive buds down the lane.
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Blueberry prides herself on being eclectic as well as electric. "I like to keep 'em guessing," she says. "A zombie should always be like, 'Whoa, didn't see that coming,' when it's disintegrated."
ELECTRICBLUEBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Blueberries randomly electrocute zombies every so often.
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (electric fence)

{FLAVOR}"Electricity is all very well and fine as a phenomenon," says Electric Currant, "but electromagnetism as a whole is where it's really at."
ELECTRICCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Currants create electrical fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Dipping tea bags into a cup of water has always been the way to prepare your tea, but doing so with him might not be such a good idea. Actually, just don't consume Electrici-tea in general.
ELECTRICITEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electrici-teas wait and emit zaps of electrical energy until they are eaten, at which point the eating zombies explode in a flurry of electrical discharges.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Electric Peashooter expects resistance, but he doesn't want to ohm anybody.
ELECTRICPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Electric Peashooters fire pea-like orbs that pass through zombies and crackle with electrical power, doing damage all the while.
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Has grown tired of people lazily calling him E.M. Pea. "There's a C and H there for a reason people! And I've got the stone to prove it!"
EMPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: E.M.Peaches explode and disable all machines in an area.
EMPEA_TOOLTIP: Disables all machines in an area
ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Enchant-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Caulipower
{STAT}Ghost Pepper
{STAT}Hocus Crocus
{STAT}Hypno-shroom
{STAT}Imitater
{STAT}Intensive Carrot
{STAT}Power Lily
{STAT}Shrinking Violet
{STAT}Tile Turnip
{STAT}Witch Hazel
{STAT}Zoybean Pod


{FLAVOR}"I just love musical theater," says Enchant-mint. Yeah, it doesn't have much to do with magic or his abilities or strategic strengths, but it's a fact. He just likes the songs.
ENCHANTMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"When other plants talk about me, they say I’m too gruff. They say I’m difficult to approach, that I’m afraid to let others get too close to me. Also, I smell terrible," said Endurian. But deep down inside, he knows that he’s so much more than that. He’s also short-tempered.
ENDURIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Endurians are defensive plants that deal damage to zombies attacking them.
ENDURIAN_TOOLTIP: Defends while dealing damage to zombies attacking it.
ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Enforce-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Bonk Choy
{STAT}Celery Stalker
{STAT}Chomper
{STAT}Guacodile
{STAT}Kiwibeast
{STAT}Parsnip
{STAT}Phat Beet
{STAT}Pokra
{STAT}Snap Pea
{STAT}Squash
{STAT}Tangle Kelp
{STAT}Wasabi Whip

{FLAVOR}Enforce-mint shrinks zombies, which may seem a bit off-brand for a guy who's all about melee damage. Enforce-mint shrugs. "I don't set policy," he says.
ENFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
ENLIGHTENMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Enlighten-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Moonflower
{STAT}Primal Sunflower
{STAT}Solar Tomato
{STAT}Sun Bean
{STAT}Sunflower
{STAT}Sun-shroom
{STAT}Toadstool
{STAT}Twin Sunflower

{FLAVOR}Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.
ENLIGHTENMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
ENTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}slowly heals after not taking damage for 5 seconds
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}withstands instant kills, only takes 1500 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}roots destroy barrels and pianos in one hit but Ent takes 1500 damage

{FLAVOR}Ent has roots tied deep into their family, and keeps in touch with all of them. Especially their uncle, whose advice and wisdom gives Ent the energy to push on, and their fun loving sister who's currently traveling the stars. Then there's the weird cousin that spits wind and drops apples. Ent doesn't like him.
ENTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ent attacks with sharp roots and heals itself when not taking damage.
ENTS_TOOLTIP: Attacks with sharp roots and heals itself when not taking damage
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap Escape Root and another plant to swap them
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't swap with endangered plants

{FLAVOR}The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party... FOR THEM!
ESCAPEROOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Escape Roots explode upon being crushed, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
ESCAPEROOT_TOOLTIP: Sturdy and can be swapped with other plants
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"My only regret," says Explode-O-Nut, "is that I have but one chewy center full of nitroglycerine to give in defense of this lawn."
EXPLODEONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Nuts provide protection, and when their shells are eaten, they explode to blow up zombies.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{FLAVOR}
Explode-O-Vine is sooooooooooooooo ready to explode. Just ridiculously ready. He's got the color picked out and everything.
EXPLODEOVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Explode-O-Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide protection, detonate an explosion with knockback when planted, and then another explosion when eaten.
EXPLODEOVINE_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside, explodes and knocks back
FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Electricity Family Plants:
{STAT}Citron
{STAT}Electric Blueberry
{STAT}Electric Currant
{STAT}Electric Peashooter
{STAT}Electrici-tea
{STAT}E. M. Peach
{STAT}Laser Bean
{STAT}Lightning Reed
{STAT}Magnifying Grass
{STAT}Ultomato

{FLAVOR}Tried swimming with electric eels and got more than he bargained for.
FILAMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to shoot a plasma pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost 
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Fire Peashooter knows that what she does looks exciting. But working with an open flame is serious and, more importantly, dangerous business.  That's why, in her spare time, she talks to children about the importance of fire safety. "I'm a trained professional," she explains. "Don't try this at home, kids."
FIREPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fire Peashooters shoot flaming peas down the lane.
FIREPEASHOOTER_TOOLTIP: Shoots flaming peas and warms nearby plants
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}attack slows down when at half health

{FLAVOR}Frozen Pear is a tourist by heart, and will take any opportunity she can to visit new worlds. As such, she will frequently update the viewers of her vlog constantly whenever she can. "This place is so much more relaxing compared to the last place I went to," she says in her most recent upload. "There were so many scary zombies there! Especially that one on the wheelchair, I still have nightmares of that one." She shivers fearfully. "I'm just glad here has all these crazy holidays they love to celebrate. And I want you guys to guess my favorite in the replies!"
FROZENPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Frozen Pears can release impact waves that damage, freeze, and chill all nearby zombies when they get close.
FROZENPEAR_TOOLTIP: Blocks zombies while freezing them in a 3x3 area
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"I think of myself as a pretty confident shroom and an all-around fungi," says Fume-shroom. "But sometimes, when I'm eating Plant Food, I hear them chuckling. I hear them calling me 'Balloon-shroom'. I don't think they know how much that hurts."
FUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fume-shrooms shoot fumes that damage all zombies in an area.
FUMESHROOM_TOOLTIP: Shoots fumes that can damage all zombies in an area
GAMECENTER_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Game Center outside the PvZ2 app to access achievements and leaderboards.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}Good against zombies, as well as proof against any vampires who might accidentally wander by.
GARLIC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Garlic diverts zombies into other lanes.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}A plant with a legendary reputation that preceeds him, there have been murmurs on if he found his way into the compost in some great battle or if he's some fictional character made to inspire young sprouts. There have even been some to don the mantle and attempt to continue the legacy. The truth of what has become of him is about as simple as Gatling Pea himself: he found himself in a REALLY high position.
GATLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gatling Pea shoots in bursts of four. When charged, Gatling Pea can be tapped on to fire a single giant pea.
GATLING_TOOLTIP: Tap on Gatling Pea when charged to fire a giant pea
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates when zombie is close
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}targets zombies that are 2 tiles ahead or behind it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}You might not know it looking at her, but Ghost Pepper didn't always wear that white sheet everywhere she went. She first put it on as a lark for a Halloween party one year. Everyone else had these elaborate costumes, and she thought it would be funny to dress like a plain ol' ghost. But she fell in love with that costume. It spoke to her. She'd found her calling.
GHOSTPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ghost Peppers haunt zombies that pass by and explode after a limited time.
GHOSTPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Haunts all zombies that pass by and explodes after a limited time
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powers shadow plants inside them

{FLAVOR}Gloom Vine's gloomy exterior shouldn't be seen as implying a gloomy interior. His interior is gloomy, but for complicated personal reasons that go way back.
GLOOMVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gloom Vines power individual shadow plants and shoot zombie-damaging gloom in eight directions.
GLOOMVINE_TOOLTIP: Shoots in 8 directions and shadow-boosts a plant inside of it
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Your botanists were so preoccupied with whether they could," says Gold Bloom, about nothing and to nobody in particular, "they didn't stop to think if they should."
GOLDBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Blooms produce a burst of sun all at once.
GOLDBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Gives an instant burst of sun
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"For a small initial investment, you too can generate huge sun," says Gold Leaf. She’s a firm believer in solar markets.
GOLDLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gold Leaves create a Gold Tile on planting.
GOOGLE_PLAY_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: You must connect to Google Play to access achievements and leaderboards.
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"Spa-BOOM!" enthuses Grapeshot. "You like that? I got a million of 'em! Wa-POW!  Buh-BLAM! Za-... um... Ker-... hmmm... Okay, I guess I've only got the three."
GRAPESHOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grapeshots explode and scatter bouncing projectiles in eight directions.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}removes graves and varying objects

{FLAVOR}He may appear spiky or ill-tempered, but Grave Buster just wants to give you a big hug. Unless you're a puppy. He's terrified of those.
GRAVEBUSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grave Busters consume graves they're planted on.
GRAVEBUSTER_TOOLTIP: Plant it on a grave to remove the grave
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies with less than 200 health die instead
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage, lowers speed of zombies that can't be transformed
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The Great Zucchini has been facing a bit of a culture shock ever since making the move from his old job. "The exchange rate for Sun is utterly confusing, Zombies try to pull their tricks whenever they can, and dear me- Nobody waits their turn here!" For being a smarty plant, he's got a lot of learning to do.
GREATZUCCHINI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The Great Zucchini can be tapped on to release the magic of the Basic Zombie tarot card, transforming zombies into basics.
GREATZUCCHINI_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to transform zombies into basics
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE3_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} three-use Boost Tile every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_BOOSTTILE_DESCRIPTION: Disperse {COUNT} single-use Boost Tiles every {TIME} seconds!
GRID_IS_YOURS_PFTOMBSTONE_DESCRIPTION: Spawn {COUNT} Plant Food Gravestone every {TIME} seconds!
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Grimroses can drag 3 zombies before expiring

{FLAVOR}"When you think about it, the proper place for a zombie is in the ground," says Grimrose. "So, really, I'm just expediting the process."
GRIMROSE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grimroses are shadow plants that behave like landbound Tangle Kelps, dragging zombies into the dirt.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}plant is lost after rushing attack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on water

{FLAVOR}Ask Guacodile to tell you a little bit about himself and he'll give you a wry smile. "I'm a Guacodile. I've got a bite like a bear trap. I spit rock-hard pits with a force, speed and accuracy envied by every plant on the battlefield. Heck, I've been known to walk on water. I'm pretty much the whole enchilada." Yeah, the guy is a bit of a braggart but he’s good at what he does.
GUACODILE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Guacodiles fire seeds from a distance. When attacked they will rush off the lawn biting any zombies they encounter.
GUACODILE_TOOLTIP: Shoots seeds, will rush all zombies ahead of him when attacked
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stronger zombies form stronger barriers
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs

{FLAVOR}"I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
GUMNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}Headbutter Lettuce was recently outed during a "truth or dare" game gone wrong. The entire plant world is still recovering from the shambles that Headbutter Lettuce's dark secret has left it in. "You won't believe it," he said, "This isn't butter. It's margarine."
HEADBUTTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Headbutter Lettuces bash zombies in front and behind while occasionally buttering zombies.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can target from anywhere on the lawn

{FLAVOR}Heath Seekers have always believed that the shortest distance between two points is an elaborately curved path that passes through several zombies and also looks pretty. Needless to say, they're struggling in geometry class.
HEATHSEEKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Heath Seekers are instant-use plants that burst into a storm of homing, piercing darts.
HEATHSEEKER_TOOLTIP: Storms out a group of homing darts
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Observe," says Hocus Crocus. "Have I anything up my sleeve? Do I even have sleeves? No? Prepare, then, to have your quaint and old-fashioned notions of spatial location SHATTERED FOREVER!!!"
HOCUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hocus Crocuses use slick sleight-of-petal chicanery to magic zombies close to your home all the way back to the rightmost part of the lawn.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Having dedicated his sprout years to martial arts, Flameweed spent many decades perfecting his techniques atop of Tibet's chilling mountains. Any method to keep his opponents hot on their feet or on their toes, he knows it. He would've made it to the top of his class, had it been not for Has-hands-weed. There's still a bit of a grudge.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Flameweeds burn zombies that walk over them and unlike other weeds, can attack flying zombies.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP: Damages and ashes zombies that step on it
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire, can fire up to 3 barriers
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}projectile knocks back, does damage, leaves barrier on empty tiles
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Holly Barrier would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
HOLLYKNIGHT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Holly Barrier deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
HOLLYKNIGHT_TOOLTIP: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}regenerates health over time

{FLAVOR}As a young nut he spent way too much time standing between two mirrors and trying to look into infinity.
HOLONUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infi-nuts are weaker than Wall-nuts, but they can regain health over time.
HOLONUT_TOOLTIP: A weaker Wall-nut that regains health over time
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Don't even think about trying to pull one over on Homing Thistle. He's got a bead on you. He sees right through your facade. It's like he has a laser beam ... aimed at your soul.
HOMINGTHISTLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Homing Thistles fire seeking shots at targets that are the closest to home.
HOMINGTHISTLE_TOOLTIP: Attacks farthest left target in any lane
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}rows adjacent to Peagle Pod
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The P-15 Peagle Pod model is equipped with the highest quality Phloem cell engineering featuring the Chlorophyll model 24 Fuselage, Bioactive Propulsion Wings, Empennage made of a Wooden Vertical Stabilizer and 2 Wooden Horizontal Stabilizers for Pitch firing stability. Internal mechanisms include the Hazelnut Ailerons and Elevators, the newest Epidermis Oxygen Based Rudder, Stem Flaps, 2 Pressurized Oak Slats, Starch Speed Brakes that double as Air Brakes, Protein Canards and Proteolysis Based Nose and Main Gear. Other features include Pisum sativum Shock Absorbers, Retraction Mechanism, Photosynthesis Jet Engines and Afterburners, an Oak Exhaust Nozzle, and an Ejection Seat. 3 Pea Pilots included.
HORSEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: P-15 Peagle Pod sends out commandos to attack zombies in a nearby area.
HORSEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Deals heavy damage to zombies in surrounding lanes
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explosion damage pierces through zombie armor
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Hot Date's a charmer. He's polite, well-read, has lots of interesting opinions, and practices active listening. Zombies line up around the block to be incinerated by him.
HOTDATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Dates attract zombies from lanes above and below them, and then unleash a lane of flame when they're eaten.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}melts an ice block or octopus

{FLAVOR}How does Hot Potato stay so positive and even-peeled all the time? Yoga, that’s how. She never misses a class. Also, regular meditation. It's the only way she can handle the hard work of fighting zombies, day in and day out, without melting down.
HOTPOTATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hot Potatoes melt the ice blocks or octopi they’re planted on.
HOTPOTATO_TOOLTIP: Plant it on ice blocks and octopi to melt them
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chills affected zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away flying zombies in lane

{FLAVOR}You could say Hurrikale is a "blow hard" in the truest sense of the phrase. He is the first chair trombonist in the Biennial Philharmonic Orchestra. He is also proficient in the trumpet, saxophone and the tuba. But man o' man, you should really see him on the flugelhorn. Dude absolutely kills it.
HURRIKALE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hurrikales push back all zombies in their lane with a chilling wind.
HURRIKALE_TOOLTIP: Blows a chilling wind that pushes back zombies in lane
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Hypno-shroom has no trouble persuading zombies to fight on behalf of the plants. But he has yet to convince one to cluck like a chicken. "One day," he says. "One day."
HYPNOSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Hypno-shrooms, they will turn around and fight for you.
HYPNOSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Makes a zombie fight for you
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}weak zombies in 3x3 area are iceblocked when defeated

{FLAVOR}Even though Ice Bloom got the freezing zombies gig from her old college roommate, Ice-shroom, after he retired from the zombie-fighting life, she insisted that what she's doing with her role on the battlefield is totally different. She's not just some imposter or a sub-standard replacement, darn it! She's her own plant, and she wishes her peers would see her that way.
ICEBLOOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ice Blooms freeze, chill, and damage all zombies on the board, and more so in a 3x3 area around where they’re planted.
ICEBLOOM_TOOLTIP: Freezes all zombies on the lawn, turns weak ones into defensive ice blocks
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}Don't get lost staring into Iceberg's adorably cute eyes. If you do, it will be your last step... but only if you're a zombie.
ICEBURG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceberg Lettuces freeze a zombie when stepped on.
ICEBURG_TOOLTIP: Freezes zombies that step on it, and extinguishes flames
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}main attack becomes more powerful after being fed Plant Food

{FLAVOR}Iceweed is excited to get the call-up to the big leagues and can't wait to start refrigerating zombies whilst inflicting damage on them. He insisted we say "whilst."
ICEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iceweeds damage and chill zombies that walk over them.
ICEWEED_TOOLTIP: Damages and chills zombies that step on it
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}area effect (icy fence)

{FLAVOR}The cold isn't why Icy Currant is constantly shivering with a worried look on it's face. No, rather, it has suffered countless acts of trauma over the years. Electric Currant's been giving him the cold shoulder, he's broken multiple codes of conduct at the workplace, and right before he was planned to enter the fray, he got blown up in a freak accident. It's a slow recovery...
ICYCURRANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Icy Currants create icy fences between ones planted on the same row or column.
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can imitate any other plant 

{FLAVOR}Having studied French Theater at Julienne, the Imitater went to the streets with his art, and has perfected his technique he calls "Potato stuck in a box."
IMITATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Imitaters let you use two of the same plant during a level!
IMITATER_TOOLTIP: Lets you have two of the same plant
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten

{FLAVOR}Imp Pear impairs zombies. Of course, Imps don’t appreciate this characterization, but who cares?
IMPPEAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: When zombies eat Imp Pears, they become Imps. When Imps eat Imp Pears, they are destroyed, releasing stunning gas.
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Inferno doesn't feel like he gets enough credit. "Of course I burn zombies," he fumes. "That's a given. But what about how I sweep them down the lane through the sheer force of hot air? Where's my prize for that?"
INFERNO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Infernos swirl up devastating fire tornados that sweep zombies back, burning and damaging them.
INFERNO_TOOLTIP: Shoots tornadoes that burn and push back zombies
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fog makes zombies allergic to buffs
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}remove debuffs from nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}uses buffs and debuffs to upgrade into 2 different ranks, temporarily increases damage and size of fog

{FLAVOR}Story goes of a deeply ingrained mushroom that stood peacefully in a forest. Each and every day, the mushroom watched as a group of frolicking plants were having fun dancing and singing with each other. Wanting to join them in harmony, the mushroom wished for a way to unroot itself... until one day, her wish was met in an unexpected and hazy way.
INKBLOT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Haze-shroom sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals.
INKBLOT_TOOLTIP: Sneezes fog that becomes stronger the more buffs it steals
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"How do I revive defeated plants?" asks Intensive Carrot. "In a word: vitamins. Vitamins and sorcery."
INTENSIVECARROT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Intensive Carrots bring eaten plants back to life.
INTENSIVECARROT_TOOLTIP: Brings eaten plants back to life
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire recharges over time
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}"Boo! Mwah-ha-ha-haaaaah," opines Jack O' Lantern. Oh, yes. Things and stuff are scheduled to be seriously spooky when he's around. Count on it.
JACKOLANTERN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jack O’ Lanterns spray fire down a lane, doing extensive burning damage over a short distance.
JACKOLANTERN_TOOLTIP: Fires jets of flame over a short distance
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}This jalapeno is one spicy character by day and The Macramé Vigilante by night. You might be wondering what his secret weapon is... it's knots.
JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Jalapenos destroy an entire lane of zombies.
JALAPENO_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire lane of zombies
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}butter immobilizes zombies

{FLAVOR}While working as an usher at the local movieplex, he saw "Fried Green Tomatoes" and found his higher calling. He packed up his husks, his kernels, his butter, and enlisted.
KERNELPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kernel-pults fling corn kernels and butter at zombies.
KERNELPULT_TOOLTIP: Flings corn kernels and butter at zombies
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}knocks back zombies 1 tile during growth, can only grow twice

{FLAVOR}"I like to keep an even keel," says Kiwibeast. "But zombies... oooh... zombies make me so mad! And when I get mad... RARRRRRGGG!"
KIWIBEAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Kiwibeasts emit damaging thumps, and become bigger and more powerful the more they are hurt by zombies.
KIWIBEAST_TOOLTIP: Becomes more powerful as it takes damage
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}After a laser eye surgery had gone horribly right, Laser Bean gained a sense of purpose and a new-found affinity for competitive staring contests.
LASER_BEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Laser Beans fire down a lane, hitting all zombies ahead of it.
LASER_BEAN_TOOLTIP: Shoots a laser that pierces through zombies
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}erupts, damaging nearby zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates a burning lava pool in its tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants
 
{FLAVOR}Lava Guava frowns with barely-repressed rage. He’s trying to keep it in check. He’s trying so hard. But one day some zombie’s going to push him too far, and he can’t be held responsible for the consequences.
LAVAGUAVA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lava Guavas erupt, creating a lava pool that burns zombies.
LAVAGUAVA_TOOLTIP: Erupts and leaves behind a burning lava pool
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}This may come as a shock, but Lightning Reed has a serious passion for ham radio. His call sign is El3ctric H1ccup. You can tune in every Tuesday to hear him read the classics to elderly plants. This week: Seeds and Sensibility.
LIGHTNINGREED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lightning Reeds shoot lightning at the nearest zombie up to one lane away. The bolt will then arc and hit other zombies.
LIGHTNINGREED_TOOLTIP: Zaps several chickens or zombies per strike
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can also be planted under non-aquatic plants

{FLAVOR}Not many people know this, but Lily Pad absolutely loves square dancing. There he is, a circular plant gliding across the dance floor making squares. He loves how it pushes his boundaries and really makes him think outside the sphere.
LILYPAD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lily Pads let you plant non-aquatic plants on top of them.
LILYPAD_TOOLTIP: Lets you plant non-aquatic plants on top of it
LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Nispaereo has been auditioning for AGES now to a prestigious aerial dance show, but has been hit with rejection every time. "I just don't understand," she weeps, swallowing a large mouthful of mint chocolate chip ice cream. "They let in those talentless trapeze hacks from that circus, but they draw the line at ME?!"
LOQUAT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nispaereo creates a vortex that pulls zombies together, dealing damage.
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}changes its attack depending if it's planted on land or water

{FLAVOR}Lotus Pod came from an exotic, far-away land to showcase his expert amphibious techniques to the rest of the world. As it turns out, the only jobs he could get were all water related. 5 years of perfecting uprooting techniques down the drain...
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Lotus Pod shoots out seeds when on land, and fires explosive torpedos across its lane when in water.
LOTUSPOD_TOOLTIP: Lobs seeds when on land, launches explosive torpedos when in water
LRIS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}magical birds naturally rot over time and disappear

{FLAVOR}Being a master of summoning, Iris fit in perfectly with the other magical plants. She’s in a close knit trio with Witch Hazel and Hocus Crocus, where the three of them love to gossip, go out to coffee shops, and endlessly shop together. Even if they have to deal with the occasional Wizard Zombie, they all just love the time they spend together. But despite it all, Iris misses her dear friends back home, and endlessly writes to them about her adventures.
LRIS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Iris can release a magical bird from its cloak, which can continuously attack zombies and slow them down.
LRIS_TOOLTIP: Releases magical birds from its cloak that attack zombies while stalling them
MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each consecutive bounce deals more damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}after the last bounce, hats have a chance to rebound, hitting the first original target
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plantfood will permanently upgrade hat, making it split into spikes upon contact

{FLAVOR}Despite his maniacal nature, offputting smile and his association with nonsense, he spends some of his time hosting tea parties with the other fairytale plants. Oftentimes, they’ll do it with hats of various sizes. He may seem like a mushroom who’s lost their marbles, but even he has some table etiquette.
MADHATTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Hatter-shroom spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies.
MADHATTER_TOOLTIP: Spins and launches hats that bounce into multiple zombies
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire when charged

{FLAVOR}With a pretty notorious history of being a successful card shark, his roll was put to a halt once some folks in Vegas caught wind of his lucky streak. Feel free to call him a Scaredy-shroom all you want for skipping town, but he's got a good cap on his stipe, and he finds it in his best interest to keep it on there as long as possible.
MAGICSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magic-shroom can be tapped on when charged to fire either freezing, sun, or plant food tarot card powers.
MAGICSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Tap when charged to release tarot card powers
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} removes metal objects from zombies

{FLAVOR}Despite his unusual appearance, Magnet-shroom doesn't have a problem attracting girlfriends. But he does have a problem keeping them. It's the same thing every time. In the end, they always find him too clingy.
MAGNETSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magnet-shrooms remove helmets and other metal objects from zombies.
MAGNETSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Removes helmets and other metal objects from zombies
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to spend 75 sun for an attack

{FLAVOR}Magnifying Grass understands the inherent power of a rainbow. Beneath her stoic features she takes great joy in delivering radiant multicolored destruction to the zombie horde.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Magnifying Grass turns sun into a bolt of colorful damage.
MAGNIFYINGGRASS_TOOLTIP: Tap to spend sun for a powerful attack
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Marigold has dedicated herself to the Zen lifestyle. She's a team player, and gives it her best there in the garden. But if she never has to confront another zombie on the lawn again it will be too soon.
MARIGOLD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marigolds give you coin rewards in Zen Garden.
MARIGOLD_TOOLTIP: Gives you rewards in Zen Garden
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Everyone says my head looks like a melon," said the middle child of the Pult family, "and they would be right." Don't ask him if he's seedless or not though, it offends him and frankly it's none of your business.
MELONPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Melon-pults do heavy damage to groups of zombies.
MELONPULT_TOOLTIP: Does heavy damage to groups of zombies
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, leaves behind a molten lava pool that burns zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}A recent graduate in the field of meteoritics, Meteor Flower's exhaustive work on the field finds notoriety in many a newspaper. Mostly in tabloids stating that the end of the world is nigh. Despite it all, Meteor Flower keeps their petals high and their readings accurate. They've been looking to conduct their next study near ZCorp's Printer shop, for no particular reason.
METEORFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Meteor Flowers can fire meteor strikes at any tile on the lawn, leaving behind molten lava to burn zombies.
METEORFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap on Meteor Flower, then a tile, to launch molten meteor strikes
MINE_IS_YOURS_PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTI: Disperse {COUNT} Primal Potato Mines every {TIME} seconds!
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}rolling fireballs are extinguished immediately upon contact with water
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plant food will permanently upgrade fireball damage

{FLAVOR}Missile Toast and Missile Toe never truly see eye-to-eye. Hot and cold, fire and ice, heat and snow, they will always butt heads. Their arguments get so loud (and usually end up in fire and snowballs flying), other plants have made a song about them:

She’s Missus Green Feastivus, she’s Missus Snow. She’s Missus Heat Blister, she’s Missus Ten Below...
MISSILETOAST_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Missile Toasts conjure fireballs to launch at zombies. After hitting a target, the fireballs continue to roll forward across the ground, doing damage across their path.
MISSILETOAST_TOOLTIP: Conjures fireballs that roll forward across the ground after hitting a target
MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, freezes zombies in a 3x3 area, then chills them after

{FLAVOR}While she is called Missile Toe, Missile Toe has no toes and, properly speaking, lacks missiles. How'd she get her name? Nepotism! Pure favoritism!
MISSILETOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Missile Toes launch cold blasts that freeze and slow zombies.
MOONFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Sun Production: {STAT}emits sun as well as additional sun for each adjacent shadow plant up to four

{FLAVOR}Moonflower is a fierce collaborator. She'll collaborate with anything. She'd collaborate with a table if she could.
MOONFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Moonflowers radiate a glow that powers up adjacent shadow plants.
MOONFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Gives sun and powers up adjacent shadow plants
MULTIPLE_QUEST_ROLLUP_AWARD_DESCRIPTION: You’ve completed a pile of quests! Have a pile of rewards!
MURKADAMIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}mirrors damage while murk is being eaten, best used against fast or strong eaters
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}damaged murk regrows over time
{FLAVOR}
"Some say that encasing yourself in gelatin is no way to conduct an offense," says Murkadamia Nut with an infectious twinkle. "I say they just haven't planted ME yet!"
MURKADAMIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Murkadamia Nuts are defensive shadow plants who, when powered, grow jelly murk to damage attacking zombies.
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}avoids most zombie attacks
{FLAVOR}Nightcap's always had a keen sense for justice, back from when she was a tiny spore watching late-night ninja movies instead of concentrating on her mycology homework.
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nightcap shoots piercing poisonous stars down the lane and withdraws into a toxic stealth mode when zombies get too close.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hurls and regrows leaves when powered

{FLAVOR}For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves.
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single-use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Noctarine gas can power shadow plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Noctarine gas multiplies damage dealt by other shadow plants to zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Noctarine gas slows zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Noctarine gas can create exploding zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants

{FLAVOR}For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie," he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging gas.
OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_ADS_DESCRIPTION: We are unable to play an ad at this time. Please try again later.
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 30 seconds to swallow trapped zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spits out zombie-slowing olive oil

{FLAVOR}You know that old saying, "even zombies never fall into the same pit twice?" Well he can tell you from experience that they do. Quite often. It's a bit embarrassing really.
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Olive Pits drill into the ground and wait to consume zombies foolish enough to walk over them.
OLIVEPIT_TOOLTIP: Spits out slowing oil and swallows zombies that walk over it
PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}plant is lost after charging attack

{FLAVOR}"Snip!" says Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"
PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.
PARSNIP_TOOLTIP: Snips zombies, then charges down lane
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}attack slows down when at half health

{FLAVOR}Pea-nut knows that some folks have an aversion to him. He tries to be sensitive to their concerns and give them the space they need. Still, he can't help but miss the good old days – back when he was the most popular nut around.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea-nuts can shoot peas and block zombies.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}increases rate of fire with multiple plantings

{FLAVOR}Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
PEAPOD_TOOLTIP: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"What is it like being famous?" asked the Peashooter while sipping his bottled water, "I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Pepper-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Fire Peashooter
{STAT}Ghost Pepper
{STAT}Hot Date
{STAT}Hot Potato
{STAT}Jack-O-Lantern
{STAT}Jalapeno
{STAT}Lava Guava
{STAT}Pepper-pult
{STAT}Pyre Vine
{STAT}Snapdragon
{STAT}Torchwood
{STAT}Wasabi Whip

{FLAVOR}Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself."
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint Family plants on the lawn.
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.
PEPPERPULT_TOOLTIP: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}affects all dinosaurs in a lane

{FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Phat Beets thump out damage every second.
PHATBEET_TOOLTIP: Thumps out damage every few seconds
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Pickled Pepper used to be a mildly successful comic at a social club called the Comedy Cannon, until one fateful night where a heckler pushed his buttons one too many times. Safe to say, the bottled up words thrown around were sour, heated, and even a little bit salty.
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pickled Peppers destroy an entire column of zombies.
PICKLEDPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire column of zombies
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}when attacked will get fat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Coming from a proud lineage of defensive pineapples, Puffapple worries about the pressure of not being able to live up to his Father's expectations when it comes to taking his place this high in the sky. He's a nervous eater, and with not much to eat here he's found himself chewing on the bullets of which are available in excess. But none of that stuff can be good for his health, and outside of hurting when crunching on their rough shells, he also worries about becoming fat as an aftermath. He's a bit of an eccentric plant, but very dependable when it comes to getting the job done.
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puffapple can stop zombies from advancing and can deflect projectiles by puffing up.
PINEAPPLE_TOOLTIP: A flying wall that deflects ranged zombie attacks
PLANT_HEALING_DESCRIPTION: Heal plants {PERCENT}%, up to {MAX}% of max health every {TIME} seconds!
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}He's secretly just a normal Peashooter that discovered a new thing. A new thing that's turned into quite an obsession. The rest of the plants can't hear the end of it.
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spikes slow down zombies and pierce through armor

{FLAVOR}Pokra’s scrappy, she’s a fighter, she’s not afraid to jab below the belt to get the job done. She won’t, because that would be cheating, but she’s not afraid to. "Just so we’re clear," she says with a resolute glint in her eye.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pokras deliver piercing jabs that add up to a powerful spike launch that can pierce through armor, then they rest momentarily before starting again.
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Potato Chip insists that it's important to go along with where life takes you. A bag, a tube, some kind of other thing? It's all life. "March on and keep a happy face," it says. Potato Chip, however, is not familiar with the terrifying concept of "crunch."
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Potato Chip crumbles upon contact, creating a small explosion that deals little damage.
POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP: Explodes on contact, doing chip damage to a small area
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, delayed activation, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variations as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Potato Mines explode on contact in a small area, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.
POTATOMINE_TOOLTIP: Explodes on contact in a small area, but takes time to arm itself
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates one Plant Food

{FLAVOR}From seedling to sapling, to full grown foliage, Power Lily's experience as a life coach has shown her the best way to empower and support plants everywhere.
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Power Lilies create one Plant Food out of thin air.
POWERLILY_TOOLTIP: Creates one Plant Food for use
POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.
POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Power Vines horizontally or vertically adjacent to other Power Vines form a network
{FLAVOR}Power Vine's noodly antennae tremble in electric anticipation and he grins, imagining firing laser bolts at zombies in tandem with his brothers.
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Power Vines shoot rapid-fire, high-velocity laser bolts, and can increase their firepower by connecting up in a network.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}primal peas occasionally knock zombies back

{FLAVOR}Primal Peashooter may be primitive, but that doesn't stop him from enrolling and excelling in several software development correspondence courses.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Peashooters shoot heavy peas with a brief stun at zombies.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, delayed activation, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Primal Potato Mine doesn't consider himself to be primal. As far as he's concerned he's state-of-the-art. And who knows? Maybe he is.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines but do damage over a larger area.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}withstands instant kills, only takes 1500 damage

{FLAVOR}"Grunt," explains Primal Wall-nut. "Grunt oog grunt-grunt," he goes on to say. "Ook-urg grunty grunt grunt," he concludes. A nut of many opinions, is Primal Wall-nut.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Wall-nuts cost a bit more than typical Wall-nuts, but they can be planted much more quickly.
PRIMALWALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Quick-planting wall that blocks off zombies
PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"You think cuz I'm Puffball that I'm puffy, that I'm soft, that I'm insubstantial?" fumes Puffball. "You need to change that thinking. PRONTO."
PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puffballs explode when planted, poisoning zombies and briefly stuns in the three columns around them.
PUFFBALL_TOOLTIP: Stuns and poisons zombies across three columns
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lives for a limited time

{FLAVOR}Puff-shroom is hip to all the latest social networks. He loves to surf Sporebook, FungusedIn and ShroomstaGram. But sometimes he misses the simple camaraderie of a good ol' fashioned Lawn Area Network party.
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puff-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time.
PUFFSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Pumpkin may be a hollowed-out shell, but he still has a rich inner life filled with feelings, fantasies and surprisingly disappointing opinions.
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.
PUMPKIN_TOOLTIP: Protects plants on which it is planted
PVINE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You may think there isn't much to Pea Vine, but if you sat down with him over a nice cup of warm milk, you'd learn that he's basically just a vine that shoots peas. Who knew?
PVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea Vines are vine plants that shoot peas and provide a slight amount of protection to plants underneath them.
PVINE_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside and shoot peas
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms the plant he's planted on
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can still be frozen

{FLAVOR}Has considered other fire related works before; cooking, romantic lighting, babysitting, you name it. None of those jobs lasted more than a day, and they just don't suit him. Also they don't provide good health insurance.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide minor protection from cold plus an additional close range explosive attack.
PYREVINE_TOOLTIP: Warms a plant inside and shoots at nearby zombies
REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Flexibility is of key importance to Red Stinger. "I do stretching exercises every morning," he says. "It's important to stay mentally and physically nimble."
REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Red Stingers fire shots at full force when close to home and become more defensive the further from it they get.
REDSTINGER_TOOLTIP: Fires shots at full force when close to home and becomes more defensive further from it.
REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Reinforce-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Aloe
{STAT}Chard Guard
{STAT}Endurian
{STAT}Gumnut
{STAT}Holly Barrier
{STAT}Hot Date
{STAT}Infi-nut
{STAT}Murkadamia Nut
{STAT}Pea-nut
{STAT}Primal Wall-nut
{STAT}Pumpkin
{STAT}Red Stinger
{STAT}Sweet Potato
{STAT}Tall-nut
{STAT}Torchwood
{STAT}Wall-nut

{FLAVOR}Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling a little bit. Fine.
REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
REPEATER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Everyone always asks me if we've met before," says Repeater. "Everyone always asks me if we've met before. Wait, did I just say that?"
REPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Repeaters fire two peas at one time.
REPEATER_TOOLTIP: Shoots two peas at the enemy
RFL_SKIP_VANILLA_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION: Do you want to skip base Plants vs. Zombies 2 game content on this profile? You will start from Modern Day - Day 34 and be able to jump straight into new content. This cannot be reverted for this profile if chosen.
SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}does no damage on impact, but creates sap puddle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}slows zombies who walk in puddle

{FLAVOR}You've gotta see Sap-fling's throwing arm to believe it. He may be young, but everyone agrees ... the kid's got TALENT. Scouts from some of the biggest Pinecone Ball teams have been keeping a close eye on him. He could be headed to the majors. Oh sure, some knock him for his incredibly sticky spitball. But he only uses all-natural sap, so it's entirely legal.
SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sap-flings create zombie-slowing puddles of sap.
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}instantly abducts imps and shrunken zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}After the recent appearance of Saucer Squash, the ZIA continues to maintain its stance that there is no such thing as alien plant life, and that the Saucer Squash must be some kind of drone plot by rogue ants.
