While many zombies are still convinced by this coverup, the sights many Cowboy and Harvest Zombies see at night paint a truly horrifying story. Too bad that's never getting into Miss Information's news cast.
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Saucer Squash stuns zombies in her beam, able to abduct low-health and shrunken zombies.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fires piercing bolts when powered
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hides and swallows zombies that approach
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bolt stall effect lasts for 2 seconds on the first zombie, -0.5 seconds for each subsequent zombie, down to 1 second

{FLAVOR}"Phoot," Shadow Peashooter says, emitting a shadowy, ah, hmmm, I guess you could call it a pea, at a distant zombie. "Uph!" gasps the zombie in evident surprise. There's a lot going on under the surface between these two.
SHADOWPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shadow Peashooters are shadow plants that fire shadowy peas at zombies.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Shadow-shrooms make poisoned zombies poison other zombies

{FLAVOR}Despite being such a poisonous and profoundly inedible fungus, Shadow-shroom is nonetheless a total cutie-pie.
SHADOWSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shadow-shrooms poison zombies who touch them, inflicting damage over time.
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}best used on sun producer plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}briefly stuns close zombies and makes them drop small sun

{FLAVOR}"Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
SHINEVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}shrinks imps to oblivion

{FLAVOR}Shrinking Violet started out shy, but it's remarkable how discovering a magical talent for zombie-reduction can change your whole outlook.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shrinking Violets shrink zombies in an area, forcing them to take 50% more damage and reducing the bite damage they inflict.
SHRINKINGVIOLET_TOOLTIP: Shrinks zombies and makes them weaker
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can target anywhere on the lawn, prioritizes zombies in front

{FLAVOR}Sling Pea keeps a keen eye on the whole battle space. He's alert and attentive. "If something slips through," he muses quietly, "it would be my fault. And I just couldn't forgive myself if that happened."
SLINGPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sling Peas fire 5 peas in a burst, targeting the zombies closest to your house each time.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Area: {STAT}damages all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost

{FLAVOR}Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.
SNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
SNAPDRAGON_TOOLTIP: Breathes fire in an area in front of it
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}entire lane
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chews zombies for 12 seconds before shooting out a head for damage
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}has a delay of 2.5 seconds after firing head shot before swallowing again, delay of 4 seconds when attacking a zombie that can't be swallowed

{FLAVOR}"I'm a picky eater, I'll admit it," admits Snap Pea casually. "I'll eat a zombie, no problem, but there's just something about heads. I feel like they're looking at me."
SNAPPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snap Peas dive underground, burrow towards zombies, then pop up underneath to swallow them in one gulp. Snap Peas then return to their starting spot, chew on the entire matter for a while, and finally spit the zombies' heads out at attackers.
SNAPPEA_TOOLTIP: Eats zombies and spits out their heads
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance of shooting a frosty pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}frosty peas deal more direct damage, have splash chill effects, and travel faster

{FLAVOR}As a professional table tennis player, in the off-season he also enjoys skiing, playing the bongos, and spelunking.
SNOWPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Snow Peas fire frozen peas making it hard for zombies to advance.
SNOWPEA_TOOLTIP: Shoots frozen peas that damage and slow zombies
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to switch mode
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lobbing mode fires up to 3 solar peas on any row in front of Solar Pea
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies defeated by Solar Pea drop sun
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Compared to her fellow sun plants in the greenhouse, Solar Pea prefers a much more "direct" approach in persuading zombies into participating with the secondary sun production process. "It's a harsh method, but those zombies wouldn't be so hurt if they let in a little bit of sun into those dingy crypts of theirs every once in a while," Solar Pea explains. "Thankfully, many gardeners out there enjoy the feeling of the sun on their skin, it's part of the gardening process after all and it's wonderful, wouldn't you agree?"
SOLARPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Pea can be tapped to switch between a straight-firing and lobbing mode.
SOLARPEA_TOOLTIP: Tap on Solar Pea to switch between straight-shot or lobbed mode
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}illuminated zombies have a chance to illuminate another zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}vulnerable to critters and mechs

{FLAVOR}"Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
SOLARSAGE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Solar Tomato wishes folks would just stop and enjoy the sunshine sometimes.

"Stop," she says. "Enjoy the sunshine. I said stop! Hold it right there! Don't move! I MEAN IT!!!"
SOLARTOMATO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Solar Tomatoes stun zombies in a 3x3 area, causing each zombie to drop 25 sun.

{FLAVOR}"Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.
SPEARMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spear-mints generate a number of Spikeweeds on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can take three hits from rolling zombies

{FLAVOR}Being the most metal plant, Spikerock has decided to hold his ultimate metal plant concert at Madison Rock Garden. Tickets have been sold out for many harvests.
SPIKEROCK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spikerocks destroy multiple rolling zombies and damage zombies that walk over them.
SPIKEROCK_TOOLTIP: Breaks 3 rolling objects, hurts zombies that step on it
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can't be eaten by zombies
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}crushed by rolling zombies

{FLAVOR}Although Spikeweed grew up on the seedy side of town, his acupuncture business has been blooming.
SPIKEWEED_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spikeweeds destroy one rolling zombie and hurt any zombies that step on them.
SPIKEWEED_TOOLTIP: Breaks 1 rolling object, hurts zombies that step on it
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"It's my turn with the eyebrows," said Frontie. "Fine, we'll split them," said Backie. Sprouted two minutes apart, their eyebrow war is eternal.
SPLITPEA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Split Peas shoot peas forward and backwards.
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I’d have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."
SPORESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spore-shrooms fire spores that create new Spore-shrooms out of defeated zombies.
SPORESHROOM_TOOLTIP: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes zombies back, or into the water
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}gets sleepy after springing

{FLAVOR}He's the strong, silent type and little is known about Spring Bean. What is known though: his fan club is a million followers strong. And the ladies love him.
SPRINGBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spring Beans bounce back zombies that get too close. Will bounce them into water if nearby.
SPRINGBEAN_TOOLTIP: Bounces zombies back and into nearby water
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs land randomly in a 3x3 area around zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs deal extra damage to zombies that can't be knockbacked
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}springs disappear over time

{FLAVOR}She prefers autumn.
SPRINGPRINCESS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spring Princess launches springs that bounce zombies back.
SPRINGPRINCESS_TOOLTIP: Launches springs that bounce zombies back
SQUASH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates when zombie is close
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}prioritizes zombies behind it

{FLAVOR}Squash is actually his stage name. His birth name was Tracy.
SQUASH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Squashes will smash the first zombie that gets close.
STALLIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact

{FLAVOR}"Life moves too quickly in our modern world," says Stallia. "Folks need to slow down and smell some spores."
STALLIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Stallias stall zombies with a puff of perfume.
STARFRUIT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Just a small town fruit that travelled to the big city and found his way to the future. His favorite modes of transportation: conveyor belts, hoverboards, and rockets. WEEEEE!
